neighbours.label: ' for' opening a parenthetical 'for example' / 'for instance'
fire: Some birds sing at night; the nightingale, for example, sings until dawn.
Many fruits ripen after picking: bananas, for instance, and avocados.
Other cities have tried this approach (Vienna, for example) with good results.
A small change in diet, cutting sugar, for instance, can lower blood pressure.
Older cameras, the Leica M3 for example, are still in demand.
Some insects, ants for example, live in large colonies.
Several languages, Finnish for instance, have no grammatical gender.
Cheap materials, plywood for example, can look good when painted.
quiet: Some birds sing at night, and the nightingale waits for the dawn.
Many fruits ripen after picking, so leave bananas out for a few days.
Other cities have tried this approach for years with good results.
A small change in diet can lower blood pressure for many people.
Older cameras are still in demand and sell for high prices.
Some insects live in large colonies and search for food together.
Several languages have no grammatical gender, which is good news for learners.
Cheap materials can look good when painted, and they are perfect for shelves.
